title: A four-question picker at Space creation chooses niche, action and theme
detail: Typed four-question config and a pure resolver, createSpace storing niche, action, theme and an optional source site on preferences.megaTheme, a door's niche carried through the wizard, and the picker UI behind SPACE_PICKER_ENABLED (default off) with a stub preview.
